title: 1953 AHSME Problem 11
statement: A running track is the ring formed by two concentric circles. It is \(10\) feet wide. The circumferences of the two circles differ by about:

solutions.text:
If the inner radius is \(r,\) the difference is \[ 2\pi(r+10)-2\pi r=20\pi\approx62.8 \] feet, which is about \(60\) feet.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: The outer radius is \(10\) feet greater than the inner radius
Subtract the circumferences; the unknown inner radius cancels
